_about: Which gfx-core templates Normal Video may use. auto = placed by the narration planner (its own extractor, a variant of a fact it reads, or a rule in normal_gfx/rules.py); doc = placed by the Doc Style detectors; manual = allowed but never placed automatically; full_frame = opaque card, disabled by default; excluded = needs a map. Change a mode here, not in code.
